_comment: AN ELECTROMAGNET, so it needs control as well as mass.
Stock recipe wanted 4 gold, lapis, an ENDER EYE and a diamond. Gold becomes copper because
copper is the everyman metal here and gold is the gated one; the eye and the diamond become
Fused Circuitry, which is a Nether material and so a real tier step rather than a reskin.
TEMPORARY, and it is another mod's resource location (#269).
This file sits at simplemagnets' OWN recipe id, which is how an override works and also how it
fails: load order decides who wins, and the loser is silent. Hence ordering = "AFTER" on the
optional simplemagnets dependency in neoforge.mods.toml. This mod has the scar already - with
ordering = "NONE" on the neoforge dependency, seventeen found-only overrides were ignored with
no error anywhere, and it was only caught because corrupting one produced no parse error at all.
Land this at the wrong id and it is not an override at all: it is a SECOND recipe, and if the
grid matches theirs only one of the two can ever be crafted. That is what
every_crafting_recipe_is_reachable_at_a_bench guards for our own recipes, and it CANNOT see this
one - simplemagnets is not loaded at test time. Verify in game, not in CI.
The pack should be shipping this, not the engine. It is here only because the pack cannot ship
data on 26.1.2; it leaves when KubeJS is fixed - Flatts3000/trashlands#47.
